      • connCheckErrorCode

        @NameInMap(value="ConnCheckErrorCode")
public String connCheckErrorCode

        The connectivity diagnostic error code. Valid values:

        • SRC_IP_NOT_IN_USER_WHITELIST: The source IP address is not added to the whitelist.
        • CONNECTION_ABNORMAL: The connection is abnormal.
        example:

        SRC_IP_NOT_IN_USER_WHITELIST

      • connCheckErrorMessage

        @NameInMap(value="ConnCheckErrorMessage")
public String connCheckErrorMessage

        The connectivity diagnostic error message.

        example:

        Src ip:39.106.64.59 not in user whitelist

      • connCheckResult

        @NameInMap(value="ConnCheckResult")

        • Success

        Failed
